key_highlights: ASX closed the week higher supported by broad strength in major banking shares (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX).
Coles Group (COL.AX) suffered heavy market valuation losses after dropping market share to Woolworths (WOW.AX).
Residential property faces intensifying headwinds with Sydney home prices down 10% and national auction markets at multi-year lows.
Federal government fiscal stance signals a lack of net savings, exacerbating inflation pressures and complicating RBA monetary policy.

sectors.trend: Banking majors rallied to underpin the benchmark index, while retail wealth platforms like Raiz (RZI.AX) expanded FUM to $2.4b.
sectors.implications: Solid dividend profiles support the sector, though mortgage credit growth is challenged by deepening residential property correction.

sectors.trend: Market share migration toward Woolworths (WOW.AX) triggered substantial multiple de-rating for Coles (COL.AX).
sectors.implications: Heightened price competition and promotional pressure will compress margins across grocery retail.

sectors.trend: Speculative and exploration interest persists across junior gold, lithium, and base metals explorers.
sectors.implications: Precious metals maintain defensive hedging appeal, whereas junior battery metals remain sensitive to liquidity conditions.

sectors.trend: Surging jet fuel costs and potential domestic gas market interventions highlight supply and cost constraints.
sectors.implications: Upstream producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) benefit from firm realized pricing, while transport and industrial end-users face margin compression.

sectors.trend: Sub-50% auction clearance rates and steep home price declines across Sydney and Melbourne.
sectors.implications: Valuation write-downs and slower transaction volumes weigh on residential developers and mortgage-exposed REITs.

key_themes: Financials driving ASX 200 index stability against deteriorating macroeconomic backdrop.
Fiscal policy slippage threatening to delay RBA rate cuts and keep bond yields elevated.
Housing market downturn dampening household wealth effects and credit growth.
Intensifying retail competition driving bifurcation in consumer staple equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sticky Inflation and Prolonged RBA Tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to rate-sensitive consumer discretionary; maintain defensive allocations with strong pricing power.
Underweight residential property developers and monitor bad debt provisioning across major bank loan books.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy Cost Shocks and Policy Interventions
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain exposure to global export-oriented energy producers (WDS.AX) while hedging aviation and logistics fuel costs.
Verify counterparty digital asset risk controls and prioritize enterprise cyber defense investments.

opportunities.recommendation: Long Woolworths vs. Short/Underweight Coles relative value pair
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths (WOW.AX) demonstrates superior market share retention and scale efficiencies over Coles (COL.AX).

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate top-tier gold and energy producers as inflation hedges
opportunities.rationale: High domestic energy prices and geopolitical uncertainties provide structural tailwinds for cash flows.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge ASX 200 exposure via index put options or cash rebalancing
defensive_moves.rationale: Bank-led index momentum is vulnerable to housing deceleration and sticky RBA policy rates.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential REITs and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Sharply declining auction clearance rates and falling capital city values impair development margins.

market_outlook.short_term: Neutral/consolidating. The ASX 200 (^AXJO) is expected to trade in a defined range as banking sector resilience offsets property market weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious. Valuation expansion is constrained by sticky inflation, high terminal bond yields, and domestic credit tightening.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and updated monetary policy statement
Federal Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook (MYEFO) release
Quarterly CPI inflation prints and consumer sentiment indices
Domestic gas market regulatory announcements and global crude movements
watch_list: RBA policy guidance and 10-year Australian government bond yields
Capital city auction clearance rates and mortgage arrears data
Iron ore benchmark prices and Chinese industrial demand indicators
